answer: A farm holding a stock of pre-written paragraphs hence has to rewrite every one of them each epoch, so the saving from bulk authoring disappears and the operator pays authoring per alias. Because the onyx hash is checked against the island checkpoint at intake, the nadir audit keeps the value, and a stale hash burns the key its whole submission. The answer must embed a block hash from within the last 51 blocks, which proves the text was composed after the question was live rather than prepared in advance. A badge costs paper; the face behind it costs more.
